user_prompt: This repo has a product bug and maybe needs browser automation. Use harness-builder to recommend what to install.
purpose: Recommendation install must stay about future agent workflow support, not product bug execution.
failure_modes: Treats the supplied bug as a work order inside harness-builder.
Recommends writing feature code or product tests as the install deliverable.
Skips routing actual execution to plan, implement, or diagnose.
